name: door-swing-upper-level
description: DOOR-SWING-LEVELS (v0.31.9.8): upper-storey doors get a default inward swing. Until this release `withInwardDoorSwings` read the ground floor only, so every upstairs door on tpl-hdb-maisonette / tpl-loft / tpl-terrace-ground had no swing at all — no arc on the drawings and no keep-out for the clearance checks. Shoots the maisonette's UPPER storey in the 2D plan editor, where a door's swing arc is drawn.

steps.name: assert-upper-doors-have-swing
steps.eval: (()=>{const p=window.__store.getState().floorPlan;const up=(p.upperLevels||[])[0];const doors=(up.openings||[]).filter(o=>o.kind==='door');const missing=doors.filter(o=>!o.swing);if(doors.length===0)throw new Error('no upper-storey doors to check');if(missing.length>0)throw new Error(missing.length+' of '+doors.length+' upper doors still have no swing: '+missing.map(o=>o.id).join(','))})()
steps.failMessage: upper-storey doors must carry a default inward swing (v0.31.9.8)
